sloka: निकुम्भाग्रज वीर्यं ते बाणवेगवदद्भुतम्।सन्नतिश्च प्रभावश्च तव वा रावणस्य वा ।। ६.७६.७२ ।।
transliteration: nikumbhāgraja vīryaṁ te bāṇavegavadadbhutam।sannatiśca prabhāvaśca tava vā rāvaṇasya vā ।। 6.76.72 ।।

translations.english: "Oh, elder brother of Nikumbha! Your valour, speed of your arrows, compliance, and glory is wonderful like that of Ravana's."
